0.0: The first thing we need to do is break the enemy's defensive stranglehold. Did you see the beasts stationed in front of the Heliseum Reclamation HQ?\r\n#L0##bOh, you mean those cute puppies?#l\n#k
0.1: Cute? Those are #b#o2400106#s#k! The Specters brought them in with their first invasion forces, then abandoned them to continue harassing our forces. We need them gone. \r\n#L0##bAww, that's so sad! Can't I just adopt them all? #l\n#k
0.2: You can do whatever you want, just get rid of them. Our troops report that breaking one of their horns will usually cause them to flee. Are you prepared to do that?\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)

yes.0: Get on with it. Defeat the hounds and bring back their horns. #b#p3001001##k will tell you more.

no.0: Were you just paying me lip service when you offered to help?

1.0: If it ain't the famous Angelic Buster! You're even better looking in person.

yes.0: Looks like you walloped more than your fair share of those #b#o2400106##k mutts! I've been itching to get out there and crack some puppy noggins, but being a high-ranking official comes with a lot of scheduling conflicts.
